# Scott Parker

> Gold Coast–based systems specialist with 20 years in hospitality and tourism.
> Full-stack hospitality systems — PMS, RMS, BI, POS, websites, distribution and
> the integrations between them. Also dabbles in networking, on-premises and
> cloud surveillance, telephony, AI and automation.
> Personal home page at rker.me.

## Pages
- [CV](https://rker.me/cv): narrative career summary and capabilities
- [Writing](https://rker.me/writing/): notes on hospitality systems
- [Tools](https://rker.me/tools/): free browser-based calculators for hospitality decisions
- [Colophon](https://rker.me/colophon): how this site is built

## Writing
- [The cost of a checkout](https://rker.me/writing/the-cost-of-a-checkout): why housekeeping cost tracks departures rather than occupancy, and why length of stay is a cost lever
- [You cannot pay an OTA to leave you alone](https://rker.me/writing/paying-the-ota): why every OTA programme is optional in name and compulsory in practice, why clearing one hoop only produces another, and what the channel really costs
- [The integration tax](https://rker.me/writing/the-integration-tax): why connecting systems is the cheap part and reconciliation is the ongoing cost
- [Your BI is only as good as your front desk](https://rker.me/writing/front-desk-data): data quality as an operational problem, not a reporting one
- [What operators get wrong when buying a PMS](https://rker.me/writing/buying-a-pms): data model and data access matter more than the feature matrix

## Tools
- [Housekeeping labour model](https://rker.me/tools/housekeeping-labour): required hours, staffing and cost per occupied room from the arrival and departure pattern, with weekend loading, rostering slack and the value of a shift in length of stay
- [Room cost and rate floor](https://rker.me/tools/room-cost): the marginal cost of an occupied room against the cost-per-occupied-room figure that misleads, with linen costed at wear and loss, marginal energy, and a rate floor that varies by length of stay
- [OTA vs direct true cost calculator](https://rker.me/tools/ota-vs-direct): what an OTA booking really costs once commission, Genius and member discounts, Preferred Partner uplift, sponsored ads, virtual card fees and cancellations are counted, plus the breakeven direct rate
- [Group displacement calculator](https://rker.me/tools/group-displacement): whether a group booking contributes more than the transient business it displaces — per-night displacement, contribution after commission and variable cost, and breakeven group rate
